title: Switching bound for depth circuits
statement: Assume that for every $q>0$, every sign-valued Boolean function on a finite cube having a DNF or CNF of width at most $q$, and every integer $k\geq0$, the probability that a random restriction with free-coordinate probability $1/(10q)$ leaves decision-tree depth at least $k$ is at most $2^{-k}$. Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{-1,1\}$ be computed by a depth-$d$ circuit of size at most $s$ and width at most $w$, where $s,w>0$, and let $0<\varepsilon\leq1$. Set $L=\lceil\log_2(2s/\varepsilon)\rceil$ and $K=\lceil\log_2(2/\varepsilon)\rceil$. Under a random restriction with free-coordinate probability $\frac1{10w}\bigl(\frac1{10L}\bigr)^{\max(d-2,0)}$, the probability that the restricted function has decision-tree depth at least $K$ is at most $\varepsilon$.
